stats.meaning: The literal query component stats=1 includes local and peer stats; any other spelling does not.

seat.meaning: Local MAC, hostname, IPv4 and optional ipv4_source, stats and stats_signal; missing identity values are unknown.

perspectives.meaning: Stored perspectives keyed by responding MAC.

trust.meaning: Derived syzygy and stamp trust evidence.

dns_unresolved.meaning: Rows whose address remains declared when DNS data exists.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed literal outcomes are enumerated; The enum lists fixed top-level refusal tokens. Peer stats signals may also have the open form refused-<HTTP status>.
